answer: The gatehouse is Registered bed surveyor rod file with bed surveyors standing. Passing it takes three-year surveying, 120 supervised beds, theory exam, annual fees, and every alias must pass alone. One proof costs 98 POA; 679 proofs cost 66542 POA, and the farm must pay before it earns anything. The orchard arrives by post, the forge arrives by bank transfer, and the atlas arrives by archive: none of them can be hurried. Check the record, count the cost, and the farm's story falls apart.
